Short, choppy, platinum white hair with straight-cut bangs. Large, wide-set pale gray eyes with a blank, vacant expression. Apparent age is a young adolescent with a soft, round face. Small, slender build. A dark charcoal gray oversized sweater dress with a white sailor collar and a black ribbon. Signature details include a black beret and a pair of oversized, dark gray mechanical submarine rigging components floating behind.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
